description: Segmentation of the Model 6 cerebral circuit into (a) COMPARTMENTS — pressure nodes, of which those carrying `hydrostatic_panel` are the ones the plotter draws against their hydrostatic column — and (b) INTERFACES, the flow elements between them.

hydrostatic_panels.tilt_pressures_heart: Pic, Psinus, Psys against the heart->brain column (Hs_Rvvs.Δp)
hydrostatic_panels.tilt_pressures_spine: Pds, Po_spine, Pivp, Pevp against the spine column (Hs_Revp.Δp)

caveat: Only 6 of the 21 components are governed by a streamed parameter (`observable: true`). The rest are fixed at model defaults and are listed so the topology is complete — an absent weight means NOT ESTIMATED, never NORMAL.

compartments.label: Cerebral arterial bed
compartments.description: The intracranial arterial compartment, with autoregulating compliance. Its stroke volume is what each beat must push into the cranium.

governed_by.note: Ca is the arterial compartment's compliance; it also scales the autoregulatory range ΔC.

compartments.label: Intracranial CSF / brain
compartments.description: The intracranial compartment whose pressure IS the measured ICP. Referenced to the heart-to-brain hydrostatic column.

governed_by.note: E sets Ctot = 1/(E·(Pic−Pcv)); α=0.3 of it is the cranial share.

compartments.label: Cerebral venous compartment
compartments.description: Cerebral veins between the capillary bed and the dural sinus.

compartments.label: Dural venous sinus
compartments.description: The sagittal/dural sinus. Sets the downstream pressure both cerebral venous outflow and cranial CSF absorption drain into.

governed_by.note: Psinus is the sinus compartment's operating pressure, a boundary condition rather than a property of a wall.

compartments.label: Jugular bulb / outflow junction
compartments.description: The junction where cerebral outflow divides between the internal jugular and the vertebral collateral. This is where the compression acts.

compartments.label: Spinal dural sac
compartments.description: The spinal CSF space (Pds). Takes CSF displaced from the cranium and is the compliant reserve the craniospinal system draws on.

governed_by.note: the remaining 1−α of craniospinal compliance is spinal.

compartments.label: Vertebral venous plexus
compartments.description: Internal/external vertebral plexus (Pivp ≡ Pevp). The alternative drainage route when the jugular is occluded or the patient is upright.

compartments.label: Paravertebral / azygos
compartments.description: The paravertebral compartment spinal CSF absorbs into and the plexus drains through (Po_spine).

compartments.label: Systemic venous return
compartments.description: The systemic venous pool returning to the right heart (Psys).

interfaces.label: Arteriolar bed (autoregulated)
interfaces.description: Autoregulating arteriolar resistance. Sets cerebral blood flow and, through its compliance, the size of the arterial pulse entering the cranium.

interfaces.label: Capillary bed
interfaces.description: Capillary resistance between the arterial and venous compartments.

interfaces.label: Cerebral venous outflow
interfaces.description: Drainage from the cerebral veins into the dural sinus.

interfaces.label: CSF absorption, cranial
interfaces.description: Arachnoid granulation absorption of CSF into the sinus. One-way.

interfaces.label: Craniospinal CSF channel
interfaces.description: The foramen magnum route. Lets CSF displace from cranium to spinal sac, which is how the craniospinal compliance reserve is reached.

interfaces.label: CSF absorption, spinal
interfaces.description: Spinal CSF absorption — the larger share of total outflow resistance.

interfaces.label: Sinus to jugular bulb
interfaces.description: Transverse/sigmoid sinus run from the dural sinus to the bulb.

interfaces.label: Internal jugular vein
interfaces.description: The dominant venous outflow route when supine. A collapsible tube: external pressure collapses its area A and its resistance rises as ~A⁻². This is the vessel the compression manoeuvre occludes.

governed_by.note: derived from k_ijvs through the tube law at rest; governs how readily the vein collapses under the compression.

interfaces.label: Vertebral venous collateral
interfaces.description: The parallel outflow path. Carries cerebral outflow when the jugular closes; if its resistance is low the occlusion costs almost nothing.

governed_by.note: Rvvs is the collateral resistance directly.

interfaces.label: Vertebral plexus drainage
interfaces.description: Drainage of the vertebral plexus into the paravertebral compartment.

interfaces.label: Azygos return
interfaces.description: Azygos/hemiazygos return to the systemic venous pool.

interfaces.label: Plexus to systemic shunt
interfaces.description: Direct low-resistance connection from the plexus to systemic return.
